questions.question: fork vs pthread_create sharing?
options: fork clones the world (separate); threads add stack+regs to the same world
questions.explanation: Separate address spaces vs one space, many stacks.

questions.question: counter++ loses updates because?
options: Load-add-store: interleavings repeat loads before stores land
questions.explanation: Three steps, preemptible between any two.

questions.question: Racy 400k lands short usually, exact sometimes. Meaning?
options: Races are probabilistic: small windows hide, scale exposes
questions.explanation: Exact-once proves nothing; shortfall proves the window.

questions.question: -pthread needed where?
questions.explanation: Defines + libpthread; half-flag fails each way.

questions.question: Why gate tests on mutex line only?
options: Timing nondeterminism would flake CI; control is deterministic

questions.question: Two locks, even/odd threads, same counter. Exact?
options: No: all accessors must share ONE lock for one datum
questions.explanation: Mutual exclusion needs a common exclusion — preview of lock discipline.
